query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM payroll_runs pr
            WHERE pr.company_id = $1
              AND pr.status = 'paid'
              AND pr.period_start <= $4
              AND pr.period_end >= $3
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM payroll_items pi
                  WHERE pi.payroll_run_id = pr.id
                    AND pi.employee_id = $2
              )
        ) AS "exists!"
